name: Chijou
source:
Former classmates meet at a mountain pension house. The waves of destiny pushed them further and submerged to the edge of dark desire.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
昔日同學在山間旅館相聚。命運之潮將他們推向更遠處，最終將他們推到黑暗慾望的邊緣。

[來源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/01/vn-of-month-august-2000-tsukihime.html]vndbreview[/url]]
